prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset type: replacement for docs/ci-cd-infrastructure-gen1-gen2.png, a current technical CI/CD architecture illustration shared by THREE repositories.
Input image role: EDIT TARGET, old diagram. Replace all obsolete pipeline content and reorganize into the layout below. Keep the polished AWS-style flat iconography, white canvas, dark navy text, pale green/lavender/blue bands, rounded rectangles and crisp orthogonal arrows. Create a high-resolution wide landscape image, large readable labels with generous space. Prioritize exact stage order and accurate labels over decoration. No tiny text.

Title: "CI/CD & Infrastructure: Three Amplify Projects"
Subtitle: "GitHub Actions → AWS deployment → verified SupportDesk website"
Status line: "Current architecture · ap-south-1 · 8 October 2026"
Small orientation line: "Each repository runs this workflow independently"

BAND A, heading "1 · Validate and prepare — in each repository"
Five boxes with left-to-right arrows:
"GitHub" / "Push main / manual dispatch"
→ "Actions runner" / "Ubuntu · Node 22" / "npm 11.13.0"
→ "Install + validate" / "npm ci" / "npm run validate" / "Types · tests · synthesis"
→ "AWS OIDC role" / "Temporary credentials"
→ "Prepare hosting" / "CloudFormation" / "S3 + CloudFront".
A readable small note below: "Gen 1 discovers CLI plugins before preparing hosting."
A separate concise label: "Failed steps stop later deployment and publishing."

BAND B, heading "2 · Deploy the backend — separate app and stacks per row"
THREE compact horizontal lanes with colored backgrounds and aligned columns. Each lane progresses left-to-right and does not connect to other rows.
Lane 1 green:
"Amplify Gen 1" / "Environment: dev"
→ "amplify/backend/" / "Categories · SDL · overrides"
→ "scripts/deploy.cjs" / "amplify init → amplify push --yes"
→ "CloudFormation" / "Root + category stacks"
→ "amplify_outputs.json" / "Exported by deploy script".
Under Lane 1, a short note "Then verify deployed Lambda packages".
Lane 2 lavender:
"Native Gen 2" / "Branch: main"
→ "amplify/backend.ts" / "TypeScript + CDK"
→ "ampx pipeline-deploy" / "App ID + main branch"
→ "CloudFormation" / "CDK resource stacks"
→ "ampx generate outputs" / "amplify_outputs.json".
Lane 3 light blue:
"Migrated Gen 2" / "Branch: main"
→ "Repaired Gen 2 source" / "TypeScript + CDK"
→ "ampx pipeline-deploy" / "Separate app ID + main"
→ "CloudFormation" / "Independent CDK stacks"
→ "ampx generate outputs" / "amplify_outputs.json".
Under all lanes, a clear amber annotation: "Migrated Gen 2 deploys independently; no Gen 1 users or data are transferred."

BAND C, heading "3 · Verify and publish — repeated independently in each repository"
Four aligned boxes with left-to-right arrows:
"Live API checks" / "REST · GraphQL · WebSocket" / "Auth · comments · live push"
→ "Build frontend" / "npm run frontend:build" / "Uses deployed outputs"
→ "Publish assets" / "Private S3 asset bucket" / "CloudFront HTTPS + OAC"
→ "Hosting checks" / "HTTPS assets match build" / "Redirect + private origin".
Small note: "A second S3 website bucket redirects to the HTTPS site."
Distinct artifact callout outside the success-only path, with dashed styling:
"Always upload available evidence" / "deployment-evidence · 14 days" / "Outputs · synthesis · API + hosting results".
This is attempted even if an earlier step fails; do not imply it runs only on success.

BAND D, compact bottom architecture inventory titled "Infrastructure in EACH project"
Use flat AWS icons beside readable names, four separated cards:
"Identity + APIs" / "Cognito · REST · AppSync" / "API Gateway WebSocket"
"Functions + data" / "Lambda · Ticket table" / "Connections table"
"Automatic live updates" / "Ticket DynamoDB Stream" / "→ socket Lambda → WebSocket"
"Frontend hosting" / "CloudFront → private S3 (OAC)" / "Separate redirect bucket".
Footer: "Three repositories · three backends · three frontend sites · isolated resources"

Important correctness constraints: All stages are GitHub Actions, not Amplify Hosting build jobs. The prep and publish bands are a repeated pattern, NOT a single shared service or a fan-in joining the three backends. Make this obvious through the repeated-per-repository labels; do not draw arrows joining resources across projects. No CodePipeline, CodeBuild, Amplify Hosting, queues, manual approval stage, CloudFront invalidation, sandbox deployment, stateful migration, or browser E2E pipeline stage. Do not claim a fixed test count. Remove old local-only warning, proposed banner, amplifyPush --simple, and backend-only assertion. Keep typography exact and command text monospaced; no 3D, watermark, or photo imagery.
scope: One comparison diagram covering all three independent pipelines, saved in each repository and the enclosing workspace.

checks: Verified stage ordering against all three .github/workflows/deploy.yml files.
Verified temporary OIDC role, region, branch, and distinct Amplify app IDs against GitHub variables and deployment.json.
Verified Gen 1 init/push, outputs export, plugin discovery and deployed Lambda package check.
Verified native and migrated Gen 2 pipeline-deploy and generate outputs commands.
Verified hosting prepare precedes backend deployment and frontend publication follows live API smoke checks.
Verified private S3 origin with CloudFront OAC and a second redirect-only S3 website bucket.
Verified artifact upload uses if: always() and retention-days: 14.
Verified latest deployment runs completed successfully, including API and frontend hosting checks.
Visually inspected the generated PNG: readable labels, correct stage order, three distinct project lanes, current status, and no cross-project resource sharing.
Documentation-only update; no new deployment or browser test run is claimed.
